WITH per_race AS (
    SELECT
        r.raceId,
        r.name AS race_name,
        AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points,
        COUNT(*) AS result_count
    FROM constructorResults AS cr
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
    WHERE cr.points >= 1.0
    GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        race_name,
        avg_points,
        result_count,
        avg_points / NULLIF(AVG(avg_points) OVER (PARTITION BY race_name), 0) AS ratio
    FROM per_race
)
SELECT raceId, race_name, avg_points, result_count, ratio
FROM ranked
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
